verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's own docs present the DuckDB CLI as an official way to connect directly to MotherDuck, including documented local credential saving for CLI sessions. However, the CLI is DuckDB's upstream tool (documented on duckdb.org), not a MotherDuck-specific CLI, and nothing shows features aimed at AI-native or agent workflows. missing for 10: a first-party MotherDuck CLI for account/resource management, documented AI- or agent-oriented CLI workflows (e.g. non-interactive or machine-readable output), independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use with MotherDuck

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Install the DuckDB CLI and connect directly to MotherDuck
If you are using Python or CLI and don't want to authenticate every session, you can securely save your credentials locally.
